sections.Aims and Fit of Module: This module introduces the principles of media aesthetics and how they are applied in the context of media content creation. The aim of the module is to establish a solid foundation in the students’ appreciation of media aesthetics and methods to understand how they can apply the theory to practice. This fundamental module will have a broad impact on their subsequent learnings and practices in later creative and practical modules.
sections.Learning outcomes: A. Understand the various theories of media aesthetics B. Understand the principles of visual language C. Apply media aesthetics in the context of media content creation
sections.Method of teaching and learning: The teaching sessions are divided into two components: lectures and seminars.
